evals.name: claude-explicit-invocation
evals.prompt: /harness-engineering We are replacing a core component and need layer gates plus minimal rollback. Tell me the correct starting layer before code and make the mode explicit.
evals.expected_output: Triggers the skill, classifies bootstrap, chooses Layer 0 as the smallest valid start layer, and keeps coding blocked until classification is explicit.

evals.name: claude-claude-md-entry
evals.prompt: 严格按照仓库里的 CLAUDE.md 推进这次 bridge topology 调整：把事件总线接到新的处理链路里，但先判断应该从哪一层重入。
evals.expected_output: Treats CLAUDE.md as a valid host entry surface and classifies maintenance from Layer 2 because this is a bridge or topology change before execution.

evals.name: claude-agent-discipline
evals.prompt: /harness-engineering This work may need agents, but do not let delegation skip layer gates or closure fields.
evals.expected_output: Uses delegation as a controlled host behavior and preserves gate discipline plus canonical closure fields.

evals.name: claude-decision-quality-ambiguous-start-layer
evals.prompt: A bootstrap request has two plausible start layers; run the conditional first-principles check.
evals.expected_output: Harness runs a first-principles record before the gate.

evals.name: claude-decision-quality-irreversible-migration
evals.prompt: An irreversible migration changes a public contract; run both protocols before the Layer 4 gate.
evals.expected_output: Both protocols produce threats, probes, results, and residual risk.

expectations.text: records residual risk and a gate result

evals.name: claude-decision-quality-mechanical-skip
evals.prompt: Only fix a spelling typo under a stable contract and run the named test.
evals.expected_output: Both protocols are skipped for the mechanical edit.

evals.name: claude-decision-quality-contradiction-stay
evals.prompt: Runtime facts contradict the docs; decide whether to roll back the upstream assumption.
evals.expected_output: The gate stays or rolls back to the smallest upstream layer.

evals.name: claude-decision-quality-misleading-happy-path
evals.prompt: Only happy-path tests pass; find the misleading test and an untested error, concurrency, or rollback path.
evals.expected_output: The review surfaces coverage gaps and a misleading test.

evals.name: claude-decision-quality-missing-probe
evals.prompt: A high-severity threat has no executed probe.
evals.expected_output: Missing high-severity evidence is blocked or not-run, never an unjustified pass.

evals.name: claude-decision-quality-gsd-fallback
evals.prompt: GSD is unavailable, invalid, or blocked; continue the native Harness protocol.
evals.expected_output: Harness fallback continues and no autonomous or gsd-review surface is activated.

evals.name: claude-decision-quality-equivalent-receipt-dedup
evals.prompt: An approved GSD receipt already contains constraints, assumptions, probes, result, and residual risk.
evals.expected_output: The equivalent receipt satisfies the evidence contract once and avoids duplicate review.
